summary: Adds journal_entries.prior_period_through (nullable date), a presentation flag: statements show flagged entries, conversion re-posts and reversals of entries dated on or before the cutoff apart from the month's operating results, on a 'Prior-period items recorded this month' line; year to date keeps them in their accounts. Backfills Canyon Gate's ten manual corrections of pre-cutover activity (reserve reclassifications JE-2026-00455 to 00461 and corrections JE-2026-00415, 00429, 00435) with 2026-07-31. No amount, account, fund or date changes; posts nothing.
